# ChoiceTile

One large square choice in a single-choice grid: the rate-a-meal taste, plate cleared and want-it-again steps; a row of them is the cooking-time selector.

`NomNom.ChoiceTile` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.ChoiceTile title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.ChoiceTile" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One large choice in a single-choice grid. `reaction` tints a taste step. `square: false` keeps the height to its copy.

| `numeral` | `boolean` |  |
